story.whoTheyAre: A national movement of local Clubs that keep kids future-ready when the school day ends.
story.whyTheyExist: Millions of kids lack supervised, enriching after-school time — Clubs close that gap with belonging.
story.whoTheyHelp: Kids and teens who need a safe place, mentors, and a path to graduate and lead.
story.whyItMatters: America’s future is decided in the hours after school — who is watching and who is believing.
story.whatChanges: Kids move from unsupervised hours to belonging, leadership, and plans after high school.

memberHome.whereYouAre: Connected to the Club movement that keeps kids future-ready after school.

memberHome.purpose: Give every kid a door that opens toward belonging and leadership.
memberHome.whatSuccessLooksLike: Kids known by name, supervised after school, expecting to graduate and lead.
